company.name: Per Vices
company.shortDescription: Per Vices, an SDR platform, enables software developers to write applications to interact with all types of wireless signals and devices.
company.description: We build high performance software defined radio platforms that are easy to integrate and can be used for a variety of applications.

productsAndServices.description: A software defined radio platform with up to 16 independent transmit or receive channels, tuning from near DC to 18 GHz, supporting up to 1 GHz RF bandwidth per channel and digital throughput up to 400 Gbps.
productsAndServices.name: Cyan

productsAndServices.description: A flexible SDR platform with 4 receive and 4 transmit channels, tuning from near DC to 6 GHz, supporting up to 325 MHz bandwidth per channel and 20 Gbps digital throughput.
productsAndServices.name: Crimson TNG

productsAndServices.description: An SDR platform with 4 receive and 4 transmit channels, tuning from near DC to 9 GHz, supporting up to 500 MHz bandwidth per channel and 160 Gbps digital throughput.
productsAndServices.name: Chestnut

productsAndServices.description: A software defined radio receiver with 4 independent receive channels, tuning from near DC to 40 GHz, supporting up to 300 MHz bandwidth per channel and 20 Gbps digital throughput.
productsAndServices.name: Calamine

productsAndServices.description: Custom-built host systems for processing, storage, and recording of data from SDR platforms, pre-configured for immediate use and extendable to meet evolving project needs.
productsAndServices.name: Host & Storage Solutions
